messages.en: Farah, I need a bit of help. My car’s broken down by the side of the road.
Where are you? Just send me your location. I’m on my way.
I’m about to head out. The meeting’s at two, right?
There’s been a slight change. The meeting won’t start until three.
I handed in my medical claim form to HR earlier. Have you handed yours in?
Not yet. I’m going to hand it in this afternoon. I just haven’t dug out the receipt yet.
My stomach hurts. You guys go ahead and eat.
Do you want to head home? I can go with you.
